'''Jake Sirrom''' hailed from [[Dahvil]], and his mother was [[Gem Sirrom/Legends|Gem Sirrom]],<ref name="SWI" /> who worked in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]<ref name="db">{{DB|character|gemsirrom|Sirrom, Gem}}</ref> and represented Jake's home [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FB" /> prior to the Republic's dissolution and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forming in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Following the Galactic Senate's dissolution, Jake's mother took him to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to start a new life,<ref name="SWI" /> and Jake joined the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]] protecting the planet's [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="ESB" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied]] Bespin, Sirrom was in one of Cloud City's buildings, walking along a corridor, when the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], warned the citizens via intercom about the Imperial takeover and advised them to leave before the Imperial presence increased.<ref name="ESB" /> Sirrom was a fair-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SWI" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]].<ref name="FB" /> During his service in the Bespin Wing Guard, Jake Sirrom wore the standard [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and wielded a [[Relby-k23 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jake Sirrom first appeared in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], an [[original trilogy]] film that came out in [[1980]].<ref name="ESB" /> On [[March 11]], [[2014]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> he was first named by the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards]]" published in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 148|148th issue]]. The article was written by [[Kevin Beentjes]], [[Sander de Lange]], and [[Tim Veekhoven]].<ref name="SWI" /> In terms of Sirrom's individual characteristics, the authors intended for nearly all the Wing Guard members included to be "good guys" who opposed the corruption that was prevalent under the leadership of Cloud City's previous Baron Administrator, [[Dominic Raynor]]. The only exceptions were the members who had been previously established as corrupt.<ref name="FB" />
